history.summary: plan.md is complete and committed (d2db73f): task shape cross-cutting, six phases — the ArgoCDDeploy wrapper chart and the repo's gate, notifications/SSO/repo credentials, the AppProject and both ApplicationSets, argocd-hooks, the relay manifests, and Argo's own registry entry last — plus verification.json covering R1-R18 1:1, the exit criterion, the relay ruling's two added proof items, gates and secrets discipline. No attachments: every design this slice needs is already authoritative in argo-cd/design.md, slice 007's credential-inventory.md and slice 015's relay consult, so the phases cite rather than restate. No phase targets the A.5 throwaway app — the slice states the proof items are acceptance, not build work, so its tiny chart is the test phase's to materialise from /work/Charts/tests/consumer/. Two things needed unblocking: ArgoCDDeploy had no commit and no origin/main, which would have failed the driver's merge-time checkout, so a minimal README root commit was seeded (e8cb797, unpushed) per slice 006's precedent; and the three ### headings inside the seeded requirements section were demoted to #### so the plan parses, with the operator's wording untouched. Four close-out entries filed: Alertmanager has no receiver so R9 is provable only at its API, slice.md's ApplicationSet quote drops the required hook.namespace parameter, the register's '~44 unmigrated releases' is really 15 with Phase B having to create the file, and /work/KubeCoderDeploy will hit the same empty-repo trap in slice 010.

AC coverage is 1:1 and Target/phase shape is sound, but A.5's throwaway deploy repo is build work no phase produces (nine criteria hang off it) and P1's exposure instruction rests on a wrong reading of the nginx-configurator: is-public: no alone yields plain HTTP, not the homelab TLS R5 requires.
